name: Innis Green
bio: a Representative from Pennsylvania; born in Hanover Township, Pa., February 26, 1776; pursued an academic course; studied law; was admitted to the bar and practiced; appointed associate judge of Dauphin County by Governor Findlay August 10, 1818, and resigned October 23, 1827; elected as a Jacksonian candidate to the Twentieth and to the succeeding Congress (March 4, 1827-March 3, 1831); reappointed associate judge of Dauphin County and served until his death in Dauphin, Pa., August 4, 1839; interment in Dauphin Cemetery.
